# Provider request contracts

These schema excerpts support offline request-shape tests for Azure ML, GCP custom training and RunPod v2. They are dated **11 October 2026** and retain the upstream capture hashes. A passing test checks serialization against these excerpts; it does not query a live account or prove service behavior.

The original specifications and revisions are indexed in the [Azure](../../../research/cloud-azure-sources-2026-10-11.json), [GCP](../../../research/cloud-gcp-sources-2026-10-11.json) and [RunPod](../../../research/cloud-runpod-sources-2026-10-11.json) source metadata. Upstream schema content retains its original terms; see [third-party notices](../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
